issues.description: Class de.tum.in.ase.eist.model.Person: the template and tests expect a field named 'firstName' (private String firstName). In the solution's Person.java the field is declared as 'private String forename;' while the solution's getters/setters and equals/hashCode still reference 'firstName'. This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual attribute causes compilation errors in the solution code and will confuse students (they cannot compile or run tests against the provided solution).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier for the person's given name consistent across template, tests, and solution. Recommended: rename the field in solution/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java from 'forename' to 'firstName' and keep the existing getters/setters/equals/hashCode as-is. Alternatively, update all getters/setters, equals/hashCode, and tests to consistently use 'forename'. After the change, recompile and run tests to ensure no references remain to the old name.
